declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartMetric_chartLift
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(anchor : M) (F : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.Bilin) (z : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E), z ∈ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).target →
_root_.CovariantDerivative.chartMetric (I := Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) (Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F) anchor z = F z

declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift_symmetric
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(anchor : M) (F : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.Bilin), (∀ z v w : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E, F z v w = F z w v) →
∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) x), Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x v w = Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x w v

declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift_coordinates
declarations.lean_type:

[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(anchor : M) (F : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.Bilin) (x : M), x ∈ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).source →
let e := trivializationAt Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E (TangentSpace (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3)) anchor
let eR := trivializationAt ℝ (fun _ : M => ℝ) anchor
((e.continuousLinearMap (RingHom.id ℝ) (e.continuousLinearMap (RingHom.id ℝ) eR))
 ⟨x, Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x⟩).2 = F ((extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor) x)
